verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developers.fathom.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It holds a structured index of the docs pages, all served as raw .md files that an agent can follow directly. The docs also ship agent-facing MCP setup guides, which add to the agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probed paths returned 404).
